SUBJECT: Requested Rezoning and Planned Development for Hotel and Event Center

During the last update to the City’s Comprehensive plan, the parcel was on the dividing line of what is recommended to be commercial and residential. During the 2023 Corridor Plan, the property was recommended to be changed to commercial. Lastly, in the FM 720 Overlay Plan, the future land use for the property is recommended to be “Corridor Residential” which is a residential use where most lot sizes are no less than 7,500 square feet, or about 1/6 of an acre.

Towards the front/center of the property is a three-story hotel with 110 rooms, a restaurant, and other accessory uses. Towards the rear/south of the site is a ~18,000 square foot event center. Along the perimeter of the building are parking areas, some outdoor event space, and a perimeter screen. The applicant is asking for a zoning change in order to allow the requested use and associated variances of development standards.
